r.정치 구도: A federal parliamentary system led by the prime minister, with the British monarch as formal head of state; a 1999 referendum to become a republic failed. Voting is compulsory, so turnout is around 90%, and the House of Representatives uses preferential voting, in which voters rank candidates. Labor and the Liberal-National coalition take turns in power. A 2023 referendum to enshrine an Indigenous Voice in the constitution was defeated.

t.why: A resource power supplying iron ore, coal and LNG to Asian factories and power plants. A longtime US ally, it belongs to the Five Eyes, the Quad and AUKUS with the United States and Britain, through which it is acquiring nuclear-powered submarines. Its largest trading partner is China, so its balancing act between the two is frequent news, as when China blocked Australian coal, wine and barley around 2020. It is increasing aid and security cooperation with Pacific island states, competing with China for influence.
t.rel: A longtime US ally that in 2021 formed the AUKUS security partnership with the United States and Britain to acquire nuclear-powered submarines. Its largest trading partner is China, and relations have swung between trade conflict and reconciliation.
t.korea: The two established relations in 1961. Much of the iron ore used by Korean steel mills and the fuel for its power plants comes from Australia, and their free trade agreement took effect in 2014. Korea has exported K9 howitzers and Redback infantry fighting vehicles to Australia, expanding defense cooperation. Hydrogen and critical mineral supply chains are new areas of cooperation. It is a favorite destination for young Koreans on working holiday visas and students.
t.know: Australia is the only country that occupies an entire continent.
etext: It is the world's largest exporter of iron ore and among the top exporters of coal, liquefied natural gas, lithium and gold. Most goes to China, Japan and South Korea.

Educating international students and tourism are big service exports. Compulsory retirement savings, known as superannuation, have grown into one of the largest pools in the world, invested at home and abroad.
Exports are concentrated in raw materials and on China's economy. Housing is very expensive and its manufacturing base is thin.
